Summary: D3-01 CLI rebuilds create no RebuildAttempt so the Steward never reaches S3/S4
Description: POST /mlflow/projects/{id}/runs with rebuild_of (prayog run --rebuild-of) queued the job but created no orm.RebuildAttempt. Failed CLI rebuilds got S1 but never an S3 session; successful ones never got S4. Violates FR-STW-001, FR-STW-006, FR-INT-01. Found 29 Oct by re-checking the Steward against main. Fix 8a38f79, regression test 637bf75 (tests/test_cli_rebuild_reaches_steward.py). Merged via PR #26.

Summary: D3-02 No failed-sign-in lockout: unlimited password guessing
Description: FR-AUTH-60 requires a lockout after max_failed_logins. Before the fix any number of wrong passwords was accepted. Found 2 Nov in the full code review. Fix 717f1fc + migration b7d4e2a1c9f0 (users.failed_logins, locked_until): 10 failures lock for 15 min with the same 401; sign-ins and lockouts audited. Tests: test_review_fixes (4 lockout tests), concurrency C4 (25 parallel guesses lock once), adversarial probe A19.

Summary: D3-03 One inconsistent GPU unit row makes every scheduling pass crash
Description: If a unit's current_allocation_id is NULL while a live allocation_units row holds it, the claim's INSERT hits ux_alloc_units_live and the IntegrityError escaped run_pass. Every later pass died at the same claim, so nothing anywhere was scheduled. Found 6 Nov by the concurrency suite on a shared test DB. Fix: claim() treats the backstop violation as LOST_CLAIM_RACE, logs an ERROR and the pass continues. Test: tests/test_concurrency.py::test_c6 (fails on main, passes with the fix).

Summary: D3-04 GET /jobs is N+1: 674 ms for 100 jobs
Description: my_jobs called job_status per job: 3-6 queries each plus a full reload of the lab's nodes for every QUEUED job. Baseline 674 ms p50 and 1.9 req/s max for limit=100. Fix: job_statuses() loads the page in a fixed number of queries and computes each lab's capacity once; job_status reuses the same code so both stay identical. After: 37 ms p50, 34 req/s. Tests: tests/test_job_list_batched.py (equivalence with job_status for every state, constant query count).

Summary: D3-05 Run output directory reachable and writable by any local user on the node
Description: node_agent.workspace.prepare chmods output/ to 0o777 so uid 65534 in the container can write, but the workspace around it kept the default umask, so any local account could reach output/ and plant or swap files before they are shipped. Found 6 Nov by bandit B103 triage. Fix: workspace chmod 0o700 (the container mounts output/ directly). Test: test_node_agent_units::test_good_code_is_joined_verified_and_extracted_read_only (POSIX assertion).

Summary: D3-06 Database outage answered with a bare 500 after 3 s
Description: During failure drill F3 (PostgreSQL stopped) every request returned 500 Internal Server Error. Clients cannot tell a transient outage from a bug and do not back off. Fix: exception handlers for OperationalError and pool TimeoutError return 503 with Retry-After: 5 and no driver details. Tests: tests/test_database_unavailable.py (2); drill F3 re-run.

Summary: D3-07 Connection pool exhaustion: 30 s hangs and 31% errors at 64 users
Description: FastAPI runs sync endpoints on 40 threads; SQLAlchemy's default pool is 5+10. Under load threads 16-40 waited 30 s for a connection and failed. Baseline GET /jobs/{id} at 64 VUs: 2.6 req/s, p50 30.4 s, 31% errors; POST /jobs at 8 VUs: 23% errors. Fix: pool_size/max_overflow/pool_timeout configurable (PRAYOG_DB_POOL_SIZE=20, MAX_OVERFLOW=20, POOL_TIMEOUT=10 s). After: 60.6 req/s, p50 1.0 s, 0% errors.

Summary: D3-08 API or database outage longer than the heartbeat timeout marks healthy nodes DOWN and requeues running jobs
Description: Failure drills F2 (API down 9.8 s) and F3 (DB down 10.9 s) with an 8 s timeout each produced a NODE_DOWN alert and NODE_FAILURE releases for a healthy node. With the 30 s default any restart or failover over ~30-40 s evicts every running job. Root cause: the reaper cannot tell node silence from platform silence. Proposed fix in the Failure and Recovery report section 5.

Summary: D3-09 Handover stranded runs in flight: uploads looked up under the old owner
Description: After IP handover, a run already placed could not start or store its results because its code and result uploads were looked up under the previous owner. Found 2 Nov in the full code review. Fix 717f1fc: lookups follow the experiment's owner. Test: test_review_fixes::test_a_handover_leaves_a_placed_run_able_to_start_and_store_its_results.

Summary: D3-10 An approved Steward fix queued a job with no code
Description: Approving a Steward-proposed corrected job (S1) for a GPU run queued a job without the version, hyper-parameters or data, which the agent then simulated. Found 2 Nov in the full code review. Fix 717f1fc. Test: test_review_fixes::test_an_approved_steward_fix_runs_the_same_code_again.

Summary: D3-11 Creating projects uploading and queueing did not require active access
Description: Only CLI login checked active (approved, unexpired, unrevoked) access; the ML Flow write routes accepted any signed-in user. Found 2 Nov in the full code review. Fix 717f1fc (active_user dependency). Tests: test_review_fixes::test_an_unapproved_account_stores_nothing_but_can_still_read, ::test_approval_opens_it_and_revoking_closes_it.

Summary: D3-12 CI red: ubuntu-latest has no Python 3.9 and the e2e user lacked access
Description: PR #26's first run failed: ubuntu-latest moved to 26.04 (no Python 3.9 for the CLI matrix) and the e2e test user had no Student row after D3-11. Fix cc209d9: CLI job pinned to ubuntu-24.04 with fail-fast off; e2e user gets access. CI green.

Summary: D3-13 Cancel reveals whether another user's job ID exists (403 vs 404)
Description: Adversarial probe A03b: POST /jobs/{id}/cancel answers 403 'You do not have permission' for another user's job but 404 for a missing ID, while every read answers 404 for both (NFR-GPU-030). Job IDs and their count can be enumerated; no content leaks. Fix: raise NotFoundError for foreign jobs in logic/scheduler/cancel.py and update test_admin_cancel_job, which currently requires 403. Left to the GPU subsystem owner because it changes a tested contract.

Summary: D3-14 Overlapping scheduling passes cost jobs x nodes x passes
Description: Found by the pass benchmark: four concurrent passes at 400 queued jobs took 51 s each, one pass under 1 s. A pass that lost a race retried every job on every node from its stale snapshot. Fixed by _Pass._learn.

Summary: D3-15 Every event started its own pass; a burst collapsed the API
Description: Found by the load test with agents: at 50 users 8.6 req/s and submit p95 8.6 s. Fixed by trigger_pass: one running and one owed per API process.

Summary: D3-16 NUL character in a stored string crashed the request
Description: POST /jobs and POST /admin/nodes answered 500. Now 400 INVALID_VALUE on every route.

Summary: D3-17 Out-of-range values from a node agent crashed the request
Description: seq, exit_code and unit_count beyond the column range answered 500. Now 422.

Summary: D3-18 Someone else's snapshot could be claimed and rebuilt
Description: Naming a victim's snapshot on POST /jobs let POST /rebuilds create an attempt on it. A snapshot the ledger holds is now rebuildable only through the ledger's own check.

Summary: D3-19 Token with no expiry accepted
Description: A correctly signed token without exp was accepted. exp and sub are now required.

Summary: D3-20 Refused cancel left no audit row
Description: Scenario A-18 requires an audit row; the refusal only reached the application log. Now recorded as job.cancel REFUSED.
